summary: Console RBAC: user cannot access Optimize > Suggestions (403 / missing permission)
description:
Requester: Miguel Santos (CS)
Affected user: Jean-Paul Laurent (In-product education)
Org/Project: Redwood (internal) / Console Sandbox

Issue summary:
Jean-Paul is unable to view the new Optimize > Suggestions beta page in the Console. The page loads but the table shows an authorization error and the API call to the suggestions endpoint returns 403.

Impact:
Blocks internal dogfooding and in-product education review for beta copy/tooltips.

What the user sees:
- Console banner: “You don’t have permission to view optimization suggestions.”
- Network response: 403 Forbidden
- Error code (from UI toast): OPTIMIZE_SUGGESTIONS_READ_FORBIDDEN

Steps to reproduce:
1) Sign into Console as affected user
2) Navigate to Optimize → Suggestions (beta)
3) Observe 403 on /optimize/suggestions

Expected behavior:
User with appropriate internal reviewer role should be able to view Suggestions for the internal sandbox org.

Notes:
Feature flag is enabled for the org, but user-level RBAC appears to be missing scope for suggestions read.

Requested action:
Grant minimum necessary permission for Jean-Paul to view Suggestions (read-only). If a dedicated role exists for beta reviewers, add user to it. Please include an audit note of the change.
comments:
2026-02-19 10:14 PT — Miguel Santos:
Jean-Paul needs read-only access to Suggestions to review in-product education/copy. Feature flag is ON for the internal sandbox org. Getting a 403 calling /optimize/suggestions. Can Authz/RBAC take a look?

Screenshot excerpt from Jean-Paul:
“Permission required: optimize.suggestions.read”

2026-02-19 11:02 PT — Kaitlyn Nguyen:
Confirmed repro. The Console is correctly gated by the Optimize Suggestions permission check.

Findings:
- Jean-Paul is assigned role: console_viewer (internal)
- Missing scope: optimize.suggestions.read (and optimize.suggestions.list)
- Org is enabled for beta flag; this is purely RBAC.

Plan:
Add Jean-Paul to internal group that maps to Optimize Suggestions Read role for sandbox org only. Will document in audit note and confirm via /me/permissions + UI refresh.

2026-02-19 12:26 PT — Kaitlyn Nguyen:
Change applied.
- Added user: Jean-Paul Laurent
- RBAC grant: optimize.suggestions.read (read-only) for org “Redwood (internal)”
- No write/apply permissions granted (no optimize.suggestions.apply).

Verification:
- /optimize/suggestions now returns 200
- Suggestions list renders; details drawer opens

Audit note:
Recorded in Authz audit log: actor=Kaitlyn Nguyen, action=GRANT_PERMISSION, subject=jean-paul.laurent@redwoodinference.com, scope=optimize.suggestions.read, resource=org:redwood-internal, reason=internal dogfood + in-product education review (INT-11307).

2026-02-20 09:05 PT — Miguel Santos:
Confirmed fixed on Jean-Paul’s end this morning. He can access Suggestions and review the copy. Thanks!
